caption: The drawing depicts a single, curved powder horn placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The horn is predominantly light brown with darker brown at both ends. The large end of the horn is capped with a dark brown wooden base featuring a metal loop for attachment. The smaller, pointed end has a carved wooden stopper, secured in place with a ring near the tip. The main body of the horn features engraved designs and a map-like pattern etched into its surface, including outlined areas, symbols resembling buildings or forts, and inscriptions. The texture of the horn is rendered with fine lines and shading to suggest its smooth but slightly rugged surface. No additional items or background elements are present in the composition.
title: Powder Horn
